paragraphs.text: Walassa is the southern of the two main islands of Orvada on the plane of Dominaria . It forms part of the Domains .
Walassa is the location of Orvada City , which houses a campus of the Tolarian Academy Another city is Lucassa , famous for its lighthouse.
Off the western coast of Walassa lies Vesuva . To the north lies Denawa .
After the second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria, the merchant lords of Orvada made peace with Benalia and furnished food and supplies to the Serran troops led by Lyra Dawnbringer .
